ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65:1 ratio of high-intensity light-gray/white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-intensity contiguous region centered at the base and extending through the central 40% of the fluke width; numerous discrete dark circular spots (mottling) distributed across the light-intensity distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys (3-7 pixel variance) visible along the entire trailing edge; most prominent jaggedness occurs at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature tapering to sharp distal points; trailing edge follows a segmented concave arc transitioning toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel groups (radius 4-10 pixels) concentrated on the light-pigmented outer quadrants of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks (2-4 pixels wide) visible on the white-intensity field of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, ragged erosion and loss of structural continuity at the distal tips of both fluke lobes.
